'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike [[Kyiv]] using [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander]] [[Ballistic missile|ballistic]] and [[cruise missile]]s, with debris injuring one [[civilian]] and damaging infrastructure. [[Ukraine]] claims to have shot down all of the missiles. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2023-05-29/russia-strikes-kyiv-daytime-attack-after-nighttime-barrage (AP via ''Los Angeles Times'')]
**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***Russian [[airstrike]]s on [[Toretsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], target a [[Filling station|petrol station]] and a multi-storey building, killing two people and injuring eight others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-eight-wounded-russian-attack-donetsk-region-governor-2023-05-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Northwestern Syria clashes (December 2022–present)|Northwestern Syria clashes]]
***[[Commander-in-chief]] of the [[Special Operations Forces (Russia)|Russian special forces]] in [[Syria]], Colonel Oleg Pechevisty, is killed by an [[Tahrir al-Sham|HTS]] [[artillery]] strike on a military post in [[Latakia Governorate|Latakia Province]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/300051/ (SOHR)] [https://www.enabbaladi.net/archives/643845 (Enab Baladi)]
*[[2022–2023 North Kosovo crisis]]
**Twenty-five [[Peacekeeping|peacekeepers]] of the [[NATO]]-led [[Kosovo Force|KFOR]] are injured after clashes with [[Kosovo Serbs|ethnic Serbs]] in [[North Kosovo]] over the installation of [[Kosovo Albanians|ethnic Albanian]] mayors. [[President of Serbia|Serbian President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] places the [[Serbian Armed Forces]] on the highest level of combat alert in response to the clashes. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65748024 (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/kosovo-serbia-tension-eu-us-cf2637072cd88f3bcf0d902236d3631b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*One person is killed and four others are missing after a chartered boat sinks near [[Sitka, Alaska|Sitka]], [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/charter-vessel-sinking-alaska-e013d22ef980ef35a9f66ea4f9f084b5 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***The [[Russian Interior Ministry]] issues an [[arrest warrant]] for [[United States Senator]] [[Lindsey Graham]] over comments Graham made about the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-puts-us-senator-graham-wanted-list-russian-media-2023-05-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment for homosexuality]], [[Anti-Homosexuality Bill, 2023]]
**[[President of Uganda|Ugandan President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] signs the Anti-Homosexuality Bill into law which introduces the [[death penalty]] for "aggravated homosexuality" and a sentence of 20 years in prison for the "[[promotion of homosexuality]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ugandas-museveni-approves-anti-gay-law-parliament-speaker-says-2023-05-29/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are injured after a shooting on a beach in [[Hollywood, Florida| Hollywood]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hollywood-florida-beach-shooting-93dda56246a69d8913f35349c52d83c5 (AP)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Premier of Western Australia]], [[Mark McGowan]], unexpectedly announces his intention to resign by the end of the week, citing exhaustion after the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Western Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-05-29/wa-premier-mark-mcgowan-resigns-from-politics/102406610 (ABC)]
*Prime Minister of [[Spain]], [[Pedro Sánchez]], calls for [[snap election]]s after the defeat of his party in the [[2023 Spanish local elections|Local]] and [[2023 Spanish regional elections|regional elections]]. [https://elpais.com/espana/2023-05-29/sanchez-adelanta-las-elecciones-al-23-de-julio-ante-el-fiasco-de-las-autonomicas.html (''El País'')]
